verdict.reasons: Core defects: 1) Fake/Garbled Text: The secondary text label under the 'AFP' logo is severely garbled ('Drig Irrigation Tape' or similar unintelligible characters), which triggers the fake_text_or_logo flag. 2) Implausible Geometry: The white strip extending from the roll to the irrigation lines is unnaturally stiff, curved like a rigid band, and acts as a substitute for the actual thin flat tape, failing the 'packaging not used as hardware' test. 3) Technical Evidence Mismatch: The image fails to show the required 'dark wet-soil strip along the root zone' indicating active monitoring; instead, it shows dry soil, and the physical layout (package sitting on the surface rather than the line being properly installed alongside) misrepresents the 'post-installation' state.

acceptance_decision.source: user requested practical >=90 acceptance; actual saved vision evidence retained
